name: Bridge Data Centres MY06, Sedenak Tech Park
summary: Bridge Data Centres' MY06 hyperscale campus sits in Kidex Sedenak, part of the Sedenak Tech Park in Kulai District, Johor. Announced in December 2021 as a three-building, 100 MW IT campus on about 40 acres with RM2.5 billion of investment over five years, its first 20 MW building was built with prefabricated modules and opened in November 2022, with ByteDance as anchor tenant. Bridge now lists MY06 at 508 MW of IT capacity across 15 buildings, and in September 2026 described the Sedenak campus as a fully operating hyperscale site.

location.note: Sources place the campus in Kidex Sedenak, within the Sedenak Technology Valley (Sedenak Tech Park), without an address; the point is the Sedenak coordinate from its Wikipedia article, so it marks the locality rather than the parcel.

metrics.note: Original plan for three buildings; the 2022 opening coverage gave 110 MW for the same three-building project.
W.Media gives 110 MW of IT power; The Iskandarian gives 110 MW without a scope.

Estimated investment over five years for the original 100 MW plan.

Grand opening of the first building, handed over to the anchor tenant.

power_sources.description: Bridge lists a 275 kV power intake for MY06; Tenaga Nasional Berhad was among the supporting parties at the opening.
